verbs: every verb that stops on a rule of the refusal catalogue (lib/refusals.json)
about: The object that follows the prefix `qargi-refusal/1 ` on one line of standard error (the line stays under 4096 bytes); the human block follows it. The number in the prefix and `schema` are always equal. A reader acts on `code` and `exit`; `detail` is text for a person and a log and is never parsed. `exit` equals the exit status of the process. `epoch`, `state` and `tx` are reserved: null today, ignored by readers, given a type later without a new integer.
writes: Nothing by itself: the line only says that a verb stopped, and what that verb changed before it stopped is the verb's own.

code.description: A code of the refusal catalogue; a code is never reused for another rule.

exit.description: The exit status of the process.

verb.description: The verb that stopped, or null when the caller named none.

project.description: The project the verb ran for, or null.

role.description: The role of the caller, or null.

epoch.description: Reserved for the seat contract; always null today.

state.description: Reserved for the seat contract; always null today.

tx.description: Reserved for the seat contract; always null today.

detail.description: key=value pairs for a person and a log; a value a lead chose appears only as a digest.

history.change: first pin: the object of the contract line gains schema and kind as its last two keys
